PortalBuffDesc: Starts with 1 Basic Weapon Box(es).
Gains 1 Privilege Weapon Box(es) at the start of the Second Plane.
Gains a crystal ore worth 1/2/3 Gold Coin(s) at the start of Plane 1/2/3 respectively.
Obtain a "Wealth Gem" upon achieving the first 1-win streak in this round.
All reward nodes in this game are replaced with a Warp Trotter theme. Warp Trotters will drop more loot.
After the Store refreshes 1 time(s), obtain 2 Gold Coin(s) and a "Staff Projector."
An extra supply phase is added before every Boss Node.
In supply phases, characters will carry two items.
Start with 1 random **4-cost character(s)**.
All Investment Strategies in this round are of Prismatic quality.
All Investment Strategies in this round are of Gold quality.
All Investment Strategies in this round are of Silver quality, so enemy difficulty will not increase with selecting higher quality Investment Strategies.
Enter a random investment environment and gain 1 Gold Coin(s) at the start.
At the start of each preparation phase, the drop rate for characters of a random cost is doubled. This is re-randomized in every preparation phase.
Obtain a Peppy wearing three random emblems.
Gets a Peppy wearing three random Emblems. The clumsy Peppy sometimes drops Emblems in your inventory.
All Combat Nodes in the Third Plane are replaced with Encounter Nodes.
Gain a random emblem. Each time you enter a Boss Node, receive a random character with the corresponding Bond.
All reward nodes in this game are replaced with a Super Warp Trotter theme! They drop tons of treasure, but they run super fast!
After refreshing 1 time(s) by spending Gold Coins, receives 2 Gold Coins. Afterwards, refreshing only costs 1 Gold Coin in this run.
2-star characters may appear in the Store.
At Node 2-6, gain an additional choice and choose one of three Investment Strategies.
The first investment strategy is of Prismatic quality.
The third investment strategy is of Prismatic quality.
When ranking up Sparkle's and Tribbie's star rating, randomly obtains **"Fu Xuan"** or **"Seele"**.
Obtains **"Jade"** and **"Aventurine"**. After gaining a total interest of <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak>, obtains **"Topaz & Numby"**.
Obtains **"Jiaoqiu"** and **"Kafka"**. When an enemy is defeated, gains 1 tally for each different DoT state inflicted. When the tally reaches <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak>, obtains **"Black Swan"**.

Obtain **"Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae"** and **"Sparkle"**. After opening 1 crystal ore(s), obtain **"Sparxie"** and 1 random Skill Point Bond character. Afterward, repeating the character reward for every 2 crystal ore(s) opened.

Obtain **"Kafka"**. After **"Blade"** or **"Mortenax Blade"**, **"Kafka"**, and **"Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>"** or **"Silver Wolf"** fight together in a battle, obtain **"Firefly"** who can only be deployed after 1 Node(s).

Obtains a 2-star **5-cost character** that can be deployed after 1 Node(s). After a perfect victory in combat, deployment Node additionally advances by 1.SPACE
Immediately receives a "Surprise Box." The present opens after 1 Node(s). After a perfect victory in combat, additionally reduces the countdown by 1.

In this round, when selecting Investment Strategies at fixed Nodes, the left, middle, and right options will be Silver, Gold, and Prismatic quality respectively, and Investment Strategy refresh count increases by 1.
Get 1 random 1-star 1-cost damage-dealing character. When entering a new Node, this character permanently gains a random stat bonus.
Get 1 random 1-star **2-cost character**. When entering a new Node, this character permanently gains a random stat bonus.
After reaching level 1, gains 3 Experience when entering the next 2 Node(s).
Obtains 1 "Expert Invitation(s)" and 2 "Basic Weapon Box(es)."

Obtains Expert Advisor **"Tingyun"** and add her to the Store for this run. When Tingyun uses her Ultimate, the target teammate gains On-Field Strength equal to <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of Tingyun's Off-Field Strength. This effect only applies to the most recent target teammate.
Obtains Expert Advisor **Gallagher** and add him to the Store for this run. Activate 2/4/6/9 Break Bond to receive 1 "Aether Drill."
When you first obtain **"Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>"**, gains the Expert Advisor **"Silver Wolf"** and add her to the Store for this run.

Starting supplies are replaced with 3 random **3-cost characters**. When a **3-cost character's** star rating upgrades to 2/3, gain <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> SPD Amplification and <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>4[i]%</unbreak> DMG Amplification.
When entering a new Node, all characters on the field gain <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> On/Off-Field Strength and <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> DMG Mitigation. This effect is stackable.
